drafts.title: Ring
drafts.pitch: Same idea, but the only mark in Null's guestbook is the one its own handset leaves when it sets it down on the page.
drafts.reason: The handset twist is clever but gives away the reveal early, and three mornings squeezed into one caption lose the waiting.

drafts.title: Residents
drafts.pitch: Same idea, but Null won't let Cursor sign because residents don't count, then accepts a ring.
drafts.reason: 'Residents don't count' and 'I offered a NAME' bolt a second joke onto the idea and blur its lonely-waiting core.
